title: Bookmarks panel and document properties dialog
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; O-03 bookmarks navigate, add, rename, delete and reorder and persist; the document-properties dialog shows real metadata
notes: Split out of T-0222 round A, which delivered A-05 undo/redo, O-01 save/Save As/dirty/close prompt and the O-04 open half, but not the bookmarks panel or the document-properties dialog. O-03 from docs/design/FEATURE_ACCEPTANCE.md: a bookmarks panel that navigates the page tree, adds, renames, deletes and reorders bookmarks, and persists them through pdfxi-document / pdfxi-edit on real bytes. The properties dialog shows real `/Info`/XMP metadata and never invents values. App-lane work, serialised behind T-0222; feature-matrix rows stay `library` until this task verifies them. Promote VIEW-008 (bookmarks/destinations) and MANAGE-001 (document-properties dialog) when the bookmark editing/navigation and properties UI are proven on a real document; leave article threads out of VIEW-008's claim.
